sources.title: OpenArm
sources.snippet: A reproducible evaluation cell that standardizes background, lighting, cameras, and arm position for fair, automated AI model comparison. "Model A outperforms Model B" only holds meaning when evaluated under identical conditions — OpenArm Cell provides the reproducible infrastructure to make such claims verifiable.

sources.title: NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7 - GitHub
sources.snippet: These are the main code, model, training, evaluation, and deployment changes that distinguish the current N1.7 main branch from the N1.6 / 1D6 code path. Use the n1d6 branch when you need the N1.6 model package and runtime behavior. Model package changed from gr00t_n1d6 to gr00t_n1d7, so codepaths and processor metadata move to the N1.7 namespace.
